newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Motors vehicle sales soar on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Kia Motors vehicle sales soar on Monday.

text.p: Vehicle sales in South Korea's troubled Kia Motors shot up on Monday after the carmaker offered a 29.9 percent discount for their main car models, a company spokesman said.
The spokesman said the sales amounted to 8,494 units at 0500 GMT and were likely to exceed 10,000 for the day. Kia's daily car sales usually averaged 6,200.
The deep price cut, aimed at raising cash, will apply only to cash payments until the end of this month.
